title: Great God Grove
tagline: Every card is an achievement. Tick it when it pops in-game; the route underneath is the short path to that one achievement.
order_note: Sections run in walkthrough order — Grove Cove, Milldread, HobbyHoo, BuzzHuzz, then the finale — and achievements sit where the walkthrough describes them popping. A few miscellaneous ones (the rabbits, the beach ball, the videos) are placed at the walkthrough moment that triggers them; chapter-end achievements may pop slightly earlier or later than listed.
scope_note: All 42 achievements / 1,000G — the full game. One playthrough covers everything if you use the cloud-save trick for the two deputy answers in Chapter 1; completed chapters can also be replayed from their start.

achievements.name: I have arrived
achievements.how: Finish the opening on The Hauzer: grab the four anchors with the Megapon and watch the cutscene.

achievements.name: him
achievements.how: After landing, interact with the black bunny on the left of the entrance gate.

achievements.name: INSPEKTA
achievements.how: Go through the lit door into the van and meet Inspekta.

slideshow.caption: Free Bug Wurth from the pile of letters with the Megapon, then pick up the love letter he drops.
slideshow.alt: Lumber Jacqueline and Bug Wurth locations

slideshow.caption: Take the letter to Lumber Jacqueline, down and to the left — when she says it is not enough, fetch Bug Wurth's 'I got a BIG OL' crush on you' phrase and shoot it at her to cross her bridge.
slideshow.alt: Lumber Jacqueline and Bug Wurth locations

slideshow.caption: Past the BizzyBoys, find Vib by the net on the left and grab his 'IT'S MEGAPON!' phrase.
Capochin wants your weapon identified before he'll let you in the van — shoot him with the phrase.
Go through the lit door into the van, meet Inspekta, and work through the dialogue, opening the letter when it comes up.

During the dialogue, collect the 'God and human, we can solve this mystery TOGETHA!' phrase when it comes up. When Inspekta asks about being his deputy, don't nod — shoot the phrase back at him. Then grab 'Lay off and take a snack break! That's an order' when it appears and you'll leave the van automatically.

achievements.name: Godwhisperer
achievements.how: From the TVs, go up a little and shoot Razzmatazz with 'I miss what my eloquent KING had to say!', take the phrase from the conversation, then shoot Miss Mitternacht with it and answer 'yes' when she asks if you really will bring the gods together.

steps.label: From the TVs, go up a little and shoot Razzmatazz with 'I miss what my eloquent KING had to say!'
As the conversation continues, grab 'With the power of communication, I can bring the gods together!'
Return to Miss Mitternacht and shoot her with that phrase
Answer 'yes' when she asks if you really will bring the gods together — she cheers up and the rain stops

media.caption: Razzmatazz, just up from the TVs

achievements.name: Good Little Deputy
achievements.how: At the end of the chapter, answer yes to staying Inspekta's deputy. Use the cloud-save trick — quit, delete only the local save, reload — to get both deputy answers in one run. On PC there's a quicker way: the moment the achievement pops, close the game before it autosaves (Alt+F4 if fullscreen, or Windows key, right-click the game's taskbar icon, Close window) — then reload and answer no for Skeptical of authority.

achievements.name: Skeptical of authority
achievements.how: At the end of the chapter, answer no to staying Inspekta's deputy (see the notes on Good Little Deputy).

Take 'I thought this place had barbeque, WHERE'S THE SMOKED HOG?' from Capochin and shoot it at the pig by the brush.

achievements.how: Run the insult chain between Razzmatazz and Capochin, grab the pumpkin from the Bayker, and clear the way into the school — the achievement pops when you leave Cobigail's room.

Head up and left to the school, shoot the vines with the giant pumpkin, and clear the bookshelf with the Megapon
Enter the room, meet Cobigail, shake yes when she asks for a favor, and take the 'BOO!' when she scares you — the achievement pops when you leave her room

achievements.name: Master barber

achievements.name: Too far
achievements.how: Run the insult chain between Capochin and Razzmatazz to the end — the final insult, delivered to Razzmatazz, pops it.

achievements.name: Bloodletting
achievements.req: Teach Milldread the meaning of the Harvest
achievements.how: Open the cata-home with the crows, learn the song from Budd and the students, and use the Milldread Berry to stop the sacrifice.

steps.label: Collect 3 crows: shoot 'BOO!' at the bushes below the school, up the path past the bakery, and below the cata-home doorway, then shoot all 3 crows at the scarecrow blocking the glowing doorway
Talk to Saul below the school doorway and take 'I...HATE that shaggy little man!'

In the cata-home, prove yourself to Budd: shoot him with 'I thwear it on my life!' then 'I...HATE that shaggy little man!', and take 'The snacks are made of friendliness; the drinks are filled with glee'
Find the 3 hide-and-seek students and take their song lines: Frenke behind the rock right of the cata-home, Brink behind the pig past the bakery door, Tripp behind the outhouse where Saul stood
Back in the cata-home, shoot the tree by the throne with the 4 song lines in order — bonfire, snacks, join your hands, differences — and grab the Milldread Berry it drops
Shoot Cobigail with the berry, shake yes when she asks if you know what she eats, and take 'Ol' Bloom used to make milldreadberry jam for the whole town!'
Shoot the Bayker with the Ol' Bloom phrase, then with the berry, and grab the Milldreadberry Jam he makes
Go left to the sacrifice and shoot Saul with the jam — Bloodletting pops after the cutscene

slideshow.caption: Talk to Saul below the school doorway and take 'I...HATE that shaggy little man!'

Shoot the tree by the throne with the 4 lines in order: bonfire, snacks, join your hands, differences.
